modifications: Grouped projection: omlx runs its own row-exact qmv tile over the four projections; mlx2 reuses the attention layer's existing concatenated q|k|v|index_qk table (Attention._fused_projection_table, the MLX_QWEN4_QSA_FUSED_PROJ mechanism) with ONE stock quantized_matmul, admitted at M <= 7 where MLX's kernel family depends on M only (M >= 8 reaches NAX small-M qmv for the wide q projection and differs). Costs a second resident copy of the four projections (~18.7 MB per attention layer, ~0.24 GB for the 12 trunk layers + MTP head).

prep_qk: omlx transcribes mlx-vlm's FP32 (1 + w) RMS norm and its MRoPE kernel; mlx2's Attention uses nn.RMSNorm (bf16 weight) and nn.RoPE (mx.fast.rope, partial rotary 64 of 256, non-traditional), so the kernel transcribes MLX's rms_single_row output expression w * T(x * inv) and rope/rope_single with log2f(base) passed from the host; it also reads the query half straight out of the strided q|gate projection (stock MLX copies it first), and accepts int or per-batch array offsets.

sdpa_gate: omlx transcribes the 'd' (M5 Ultra) plan only (128 partitions below 16K keys); mlx2 transcribes select_sdpa_blocks for 's' (this M5 Max: 64/128/256/512/1024 partitions by context) and 'd', every context, and the boolean mask walk MLX does (omlx's dense arm is unmasked), so the masked QSA arm above the indexer budget also runs fused. The 2-pass chains are MLX's own sdpa_vector_2pass_1 geometry (no four-keys-ahead macro). R * GQA <= 32 only (R <= 2 at GQA 12): wider verify rows keep MLX's unfused SDPA and take only the projections and prep_qk.
omlx's '#if POS_NDIM == 3' / template-argument preprocessor switches are replaced by Python-side source specialization (template arguments are C++ template parameters, not macros).

Dense short-circuit: below the indexer budget (n_blocks <= block_topk) the fused rows ask the indexer for its existing implicit_all selection (the MLX_QWEN4_QSA_DENSE_SHORTCIRCUIT logic) instead of the explicit all-blocks selection; the mask is the causal mask cell for cell (tests/test_qwen4_attn_rows.py). Not used when the gather arm is enabled.

mlx2-original additions (not in omlx; omlx's masked arm keeps its selection ops): qsa_mask rebuilds QSASelection.dense_mask() for an explicit selection in one launch (chosen-block bitmap in threadgroup memory from the selected ids & valid_blocks, clipped floor-divided token block, causal tail, left-padding floor, causal mask; integer/bool logic, MLX's signed floor_divide), and index_q runs the indexer query's q_layernorm + _apply_rope_positions (unscaled table) in one launch, transcribing the composed MLX ops (rms_single_row at axis 128, f32 position x freqs, precise::cos/sin, each product and sum separately rounded under '#pragma METAL fp contract(off)', round to bf16). The scores matmul, argpartition and pooled-key path stay MLX ops.

Admission: batch 1, rows <= 17, bf16/fp16, unquantized cache, Metal 's'/'d' class, nn.RMSNorm q/k norms with equal eps, nn.RoPE non-traditional, head_dim 256, sdpa admission per plan/mask/dtype; every refusal is counted by reason (qwen4_attn_rows.status()). Kill switch: the policy field / env var; set_enabled() for in-process A/B.
No unrolled verify tiles, deferred GDN states or MoE top-k fold (other lanes / existing mlx2 mechanisms). No Apple copyright header added.
